def Heat Potato using Microwave and set the table for lunch():
	#0.Heat Potato using Microwave 
	walk('Potato')
	pickup('Potato')
	walk('Microwave')
	open('Microwave')
	assert('potato' in 'hand')
	else: walk('potato')
	else: pickup('potato')
	else: walk('microwave')
	put('Potato', 'Microwave')
	close('Microwave')
	walk('Microwave')
	toggleon('Microwave')
	#1.Retrieve Heated Potato and Place on CounterTop
	toggleoff('Microwave')
	walk('Microwave')
	open('Microwave')
	pickup('Potato')
	close('Microwave')
	walk('CounterTop')
	assert('Potato' in 'hand')
	else: walk('potato')
	else: pickup('potato')
	else: walk('countertop')
	put('Potato', 'CounterTop')
	#2.Place Plate on CounterTop for Meal
	walk('Plate')
	pickup('Plate')
	walk('CounterTop')
	assert('Plate' in 'hand')
	else: walk('plate')
	else: pickup('plate')
	else: walk('countertop')
	put('Plate', 'CounterTop')
	#3.Place Tomato on CounterTop for Meal
	walk('Tomato')
	pickup('Tomato')
	walk('CounterTop')
	assert('Tomato' in 'hand')
	else: walk('tomato')
	else: pickup('tomato')
	else: walk('countertop')
	put('Tomato', 'CounterTop')
	#4.Serve Toasted Bread on Plate
	walk('Bread')
	pickup('Bread')
	walk('Plate')
	assert('Bread' in 'hand')
	else: walk('bread')
	else: pickup('bread')
	else: walk('plate')
	put('Bread', 'Plate')
	#4.Done

def use coffee machine to make coffee then pick up the apple():
	# Subtask: Prepare Coffee Machine with Mug
	walk('Mug')
	pickup('Mug')
	walk('CoffeeMachine')
	put('Mug', 'CoffeeMachine')
	# Subtask: Start Coffee Machine
	wait(0.0)
	walk('CoffeeMachine')
	toggleon('CoffeeMachine')
	# Subtask: Retrieve Coffee from Machine and Place on CounterTop
	wait(5.0)
	walk('CoffeeMachine')
	pickup('Mug')
	walk('CounterTop')
	put('Mug', 'CounterTop')
	# Subtask: Pick up Apple and Hold
	walk('Apple')
	pickup('Apple')
	walk('CounterTop')
	put('Apple', 'CounterTop')
	#5.Done
